implementation_summary: Added recordPhoneLayout(page, opts) -> { phone: PhoneLayout, findings: Finding[] }. Sets BREAKPOINT_VIEWPORTS['375px'], waits two animation frames, measures horizontal overflow (null on error), runs UXQualityChecker at 375px with axe off and keeps only the F-UX-TARGET-/F-UX-OVERFLOW- findings (overflow title reworded to 'found' per ADR 0018). Saves a full-page PNG clipped to 375px wide (height capped at 16000px) under versionDir (default phone/<slug>-<sha256-8>.png; paths leaving versionDir are refused) and returns the relative path or null on failure. Restores the previous viewport in finally and never throws. No navigation or requests of its own. Not exported from the core barrel.
